name: Poppy
source:
Poppy's parents were both legendary sailors who disappeared one day years ago, never to be seen again. Hoping to fulfill their legacy, Poppy became a sailor, herself, until an incident left her bedridden.

After a long recovery, Poppy finds that Two Elk Island has changed in her absence. She finds herself at a crossroads when Gallardia, Lantana, Rue, and Prince Valerian all ask for her assistance.
